name: Secret Home 2 -Kare no Na wa Tsundere-
original_name: Secret Home 2-カレノナハつんでれ-
source:
Secret Home 2 is a BL-style produced visual novel.

It is a story of a young boy who is taken in by a strange home and have various things happen to him.

Includes 60 pieces of CG and 25 insert illustrations including content cuts and backgrounds.

Juices and wetness are featured predominantly. Also includes many images featuring nude and muscular characters.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE040895.html]DLsite English[/url]]
